issues.extracted: Other receipts 21,361 split into franchise tax 2,885 / rental income 10,643 / misc general 6,783 / misc cemetery 1,050
issues.on_page: p4 prints a single 'Other receipts 21,361' (General column); p9 prints the General fund 'Other' group (Interest 136,226, Franchise tax 2,885, Electric system lease 110,573, Rental income 10,643, Misc General 6,783, Cemetery 1,050)
issues.issue: No page prints a breakdown of the 21,361 line itself. The split comes from taking Interest and Electric system lease (separate p4 lines) out of the p9 'Other' group. The arithmetic is right (2,885+10,643+6,783+1,050 = 21,361) and it uses the same fund's own schedule, but the split is derived, not printed. Applies to receipts[9]-[12].

issues.on_page: Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (net position = cash 502,498)
issues.issue: The extractor rules say measure = 'cash' for cash-basis statements. The statement is titled net position, but it is the cash balance.
